fit_temporal_hierarchical_model: fit a TemporalHierarchicalModel with base models across multiple temporal aggregation levels
predict_reconciled_forecasts: predict reconciled forecasts using methods like struc, svar, hvar, mint_shrink, or mint_sample
get_W_matrix: get the W weighting matrix for temporal hierarchical reconciliation using struc, svar, hvar, or mint methods
get_S_matrix: get the S aggregation matrix that maps disaggregated forecasts to their temporal hierarchy levels
median_validation_filter: validate and filter out bad forecasts by comparing base model forecasts against median forecasts
